description: Western Florida Panhandle Electric Transmission Grid Substations, Lines, and Towers is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Zachary Schumann, Christopher Chini (Air Force Institute of Technology). The upload consists of 5 different datasets pertaining to the electric transmission grid in the nine counties of the western Florida Panhandle. The area largely coincides with the former operation area of the Gulf Power Company (GPCO) but is not limited to this utility. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
